title: Inpainting
mask: mask.png (white = repaint), transmitted as lossless mask.webp base64
notes: source_processing must be "inpainting" and the mask must match the source dimensions. The mask is sent losslessly so the binary black/white edge is not softened by webp compression.
deviations: Requested model was stable_diffusion_inpainting; that base model repainted the region but produced a flat, featureless sky with no aurora. Re-ran on Deliberate Inpainting, which rendered the aurora clearly. A faint seam remains at the mask boundary (x=270).
